values.AssociatedLNGNotes: Houston Pipe Line Company LP, which owns this system, is the seller in a gas sale contract with Sabine Pass Liquefaction, LLC, the company that holds export authority for the Sabine Pass LNG terminal. The contract is dated April 1, 2015, and its confirmation is dated October 11, 2017. A Department of Energy filing lists the contract.

verifications.note: A Department of Energy public summary of a gas contract. It names Houston Pipe Line Company LP as seller and Sabine Pass Liquefaction, LLC as buyer, under DOE LNG export orders, with the NAESB base contract dated April 1, 2015 and the confirmation dated October 11, 2017. The name matches the owner of this system, but the filing does not say which pipe segment delivers the gas.

records.researcher_notes: The tie is to the whole Houston Pipe Line system, which is the row as it stands, so the flag is set on the system row and not on a segment. The source ties the system to LNG through a named buyer, and it names the terminal, so the tie holds at medium confidence. The source does not say which pipe delivers the gas to Sabine Pass. No other source on the tie was found in a search for Houston Pipe Line with LNG feedgas. The sheet cells were blank before this change.

ledger.note: Searched Hampton Roads Crossing with LNG. The results describe a 22 mile Virginia Natural Gas harbor crossing and an unrelated highway tunnel project. No LNG tie was found.

Searched Hoback Pipeline with LNG. The sources describe a Lower Valley Energy line serving Jackson, Wyoming, and an older LNG trucking reference for the same utility. The trucking reference is about the utility's own peak supply, not this pipeline, so no tie was found.
Searched the Homer City gas pipeline with LNG. The sources describe a 5.8 mile pipeline that supplies the Homer City power plant and data center campus. No LNG tie was found.
Searched Horizon Pipeline with LNG. The sources describe a northern Illinois line from the Joliet hub into McHenry County. No LNG tie was found.

Searched the Edinburg Lateral extension with LNG. The sources describe a 23 mile line that exports pipeline gas to Mexico near Reynosa under a Presidential Permit. Pipeline exports to Mexico are not LNG exports, and no LNG tie was found.

A Department of Energy filing lists a 2015 gas sale contract in which Houston Pipe Line Company LP sells gas to Sabine Pass Liquefaction, LLC. That makes the system an LNG feedgas supplier for the Sabine Pass terminal. The tie is staged on the system row at medium confidence, since the source does not name the delivering segment.
